verdict.rationale: Archiving received documents for later retrieval is a fair question for a registered-agent service, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence on it: the only first-party probe was blocked by a Cloudflare challenge, and the community comment concerns the company's SEO, not document retention.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, received documents stay archived in the account so a notice can be retrieved months later, not just at notification time
